name: Thomas' Plain Bagel (Toasted Half)
whyItWorks: Made with enriched bleached wheat flour, boiled and baked without seeds, onion flakes, or whole grains. Eating half a bagel toasted provides dense, easily absorbed carbohydrates without overloading bowel volume.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice in half and toast until lightly golden. Spread with pure butter, ghee, or lactose-free cream cheese.
